Hollow Hound
CR 1

XP 400
N Small magical beast
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +1 size)
hp 19 (3d10+3)
Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +4
Defensive Abilities exuded mist

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 20 ft. (perfect)
Melee bite +6 (1d4+ 1 plus trip)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 3rd; concentration +3)

At will–obscuring mist

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 17, Con 13, Int 5, Wis 17, Cha 6
Base Attack +3; CMB +3; CMD 16 (20 vs. trip)
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Fly +15, Perception +5, Stealth +11, Survival +1 (+5 scent tracking); Racial Modifiers +4 Survival when tracking by scent

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Exuded Mist (Su)

A hollow hound is constantly exuding a mist from their paws, tail and eyes. The cumulative mist that forms around them grants a constant 10% concealment. This concealment does not stack with the concealment granted by obscuring mist or similar spells or from natural fog or smoke.

ABOUT

Environment cold, misty forests or fey realms
Organization solitary, pair, or cloud (3-5)
Treasure none

The hollow hound is a creature sel1om seen. It hides with its pack, called a cloud, in deep forests hunting the misty mornings. While they typically hunt on the ground where they are much quicker, they can float through the air, born upon the magic mists they exude. They have a keen intelligence stemming from their creation in the chaotic fey realms from which they have escaped.

Through a light mist moving toward you, you can see the indistinct form of a canine. The mist pours from its eyes, the pads of its paws and from the end of its tail.
